    if has_space_divider and (num_spaces := datetime_string.count(" ")) != 1 or has_t_divider and num_spaces > 0:

    has_time, has_tz, formats = has_space_divider or has_t_divider, False, [
        "YYYY-MM-DD", "YYYY-M-DD", "YYYY-M-D", "YYYY/MM/DD", "YYYY/M/DD", "YYYY/M/D", "YYYY.MM.DD", "YYYY.M.DD", "YYYY.M.D", "YYYYMMDD", "YYYY-DDDD", "YYYYDDDD", "YYYY-MM", "YYYY/MM", "YYYY.MM", "YYYY", "W",
    ]
    if has_time:
        date_string, time_string = (datetime_string.split(" ", 1) if has_space_divider else datetime_string.split("T", 1))
        time_parts = re.split(r"[\+\-Z]", time_string, 1, re.IGNORECASE)
        if (time_components := self._TIME_RE.match(time_parts[0])) is None:
            raise ParserError("Invalid time component provided. Please specify a format or provide a valid time component in the basic or extended ISO 8601 time format.")
        hours, minutes, seconds, subseconds_sep, subseconds = time_components.groups()
        has_tz, has_minutes, has_seconds, has_subseconds = len(time_parts) == 2, minutes is not None, seconds is not None, subseconds is not None
        is_basic_time_format, tz_format = ":" not in time_parts[0], "Z"
        if has_tz and ":" in time_parts[1]:
            tz_format = "ZZ"
        time_sep = "" if is_basic_time_format else ":"
        time_string = "HH{time_sep}mm{time_sep}ss{subseconds_sep}S".format(time_sep=time_sep, subseconds_sep=subseconds_sep) if has_subseconds else "HH{time_sep}mm{time_sep}ss".format(time_sep=time_sep) if has_seconds else "HH{time_sep}mm".format(time_sep=time_sep) if has_minutes else "HH"
        formats = ["{} {}".format(f, time_string) for f in formats] if has_space_divider else ["{}T{}".format(f, time_string) for f in formats]

def _build_datetime(parts):
    if (weekdate := parts.get("weekdate")) is not None:
        year, week = int(weekdate[0]), int(weekdate[1])
        day = int(weekdate[2]) if weekdate[2] is not None else 1
        dt = iso_to_gregorian(year, week, day)
        parts.update(year=dt.year, month=dt.month, day=dt.day)
    if (timestamp := parts.get("timestamp")) is not None:
        return datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp, tz=tz.tzutc())
    if (expanded_timestamp := parts.get("expanded_timestamp")) is not None:
        if expanded_timestamp > MAX_TIMESTAMP:
            if expanded_timestamp < MAX_TIMESTAMP_MS:
                expanded_timestamp /= 1000.0
            elif expanded_timestamp < MAX_TIMESTAMP_US:
                expanded_timestamp /= 1000000.0
            else:
                raise ValueError("The specified timestamp '{}' is too large.".format(expanded_timestamp))
        return datetime.fromtimestamp(expanded_timestamp, tz=tz.tzutc())
    if (day_of_year := parts.get("day_of_year")) is not None:
        if (year := parts.get("year")) is None:
            raise ParserError("Year component is required with the DDD and DDDD tokens.")
        if (month := parts.get("month")) is not None:
            raise ParserError("Month component is not allowed with the DDD and DDDD tokens.")
        try:
            dt = datetime.strptime("{}-{}".format(year, day_of_year), "%Y-%j")
        except ValueError:
            raise ParserError("The provided day of year '{}' is invalid.".format(day_of_year))
        parts.update(year=dt.year, month=dt.month, day=dt.day)
    if (am_pm := parts.get("am_pm")) == "pm" and (hour := parts.get("hour", 0)) < 12:
        hour += 12
    elif am_pm == "am" and hour == 12:
        hour = 0
    if hour == 24:
        if any(parts.get(k) for k in ["minute", "second", "microsecond"]):
            raise ParserError("Midnight at the end of day must not contain minutes, seconds, or microseconds")
        hour, day_increment = 0, 1
    else:
        day_increment = 0
    if (microsecond := parts.get("microsecond", 0)) == 1000000:
        microsecond, second_increment = 0, 1
    else:
        second_increment = 0
    return datetime(
        year=parts.get("year", 1),
        month=parts.get("month", 1),
        day=parts.get("day", 1),
        hour=hour,
        minute=parts.get("minute", 0),
        second=parts.get("second", 0),
        microsecond=microsecond,
        tzinfo=parts.get("tzinfo"),
    ) + timedelta(days=day_increment, seconds=second_increment)"}]}
